name: pg_collate_icu_utf8_disallow_partitionwise_join
goal:
A partitionwise join can return wrong rows when its join equality uses a collation different from the collation of the matching partition keys. Two strings routed to different partitions under the key collation can still compare equal under the join collation, but a partition-by-partition join never brings them together.

Join two text tables partitioned with `COLLATE "C"` using a case-insensitive ICU collation and compare the result with partitionwise joins disabled and enabled. The rows must agree, and the unsafe partitionwise plan must not be selected. A join using the same collation as both partition keys must remain eligible, as must unrelated partitionwise joins.
